channel.title: South Coast Business Awards 2018 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: Friends and family pay tribute at funeral of Gosport councillor
item.description: Friends, family and fellow councillors came together to celebrate the life of a Gosport councillor.

item.title: Pub reopens for festive roasts and drinks a year after being ravaged by fire
item.description: Toby Carvery Bishopstoke pub has reopened following a major makeover, just under a year after it was ravaged by fire.

item.title: All the Christmas bin collection changes Hampshire residents need to know
item.description: Households across Hampshire are being urged to double-check their bin days as councils roll out waste and recycling collection schedules over the busy Christmas period.

item.title: 'If only the council would wake up and LISTEN' - Letter
item.description: The closure of the M27 to put in place a massive underpass structure during the Christmas period led me to question (of Hampshire County Council) who has taken responsibility for the so-called 'intelligent' traffic lights outside Holy Trinity Church in West Street, Fareham.

item.title: Southampton Christmas supermarket opening hours including Asda, Aldi and Tesco
item.description: See the 2025 Christmas and New Year opening times for Asda, Tesco, Aldi, Morrisons, Sainsbury's, Lidl and M&S in Southampton

item.title: Facial recognition vans hailed as 'thief-takers' by city's top police officer
item.description: The Southampton police commander has defended the force's use of facial recognition vans on the high street.

item.title: Plans submitted for 60 new homes near Romsey
item.description: Plans to build up to 60 new homes on farmland near Romsey have been submitted to Test Valley Borough Council.

item.title: 'It's horrible': Broken lifts leave families unable to get to their homes
item.description: Lift failures have left families stranded and unable to reach their homes

item.title: Cruise parking firm’s appeal to offer meet-and-greet service dismissed
item.description: A cruise parking company’s challenge to restrictions imposed on its operation by the council has been rejected by a planning inspector.

item.title: ‘I will never use Evri again’: Mum's shock as van passenger 'walks off with parcel'
item.description: A woman said she will “never use Evri again” after doorbell camera footage appears to show a woman taking a parcel from her porch.
